methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The methodology to monitor energy efficiency by measuring the Energy Performance Indicator (EnPI) [32–35] in an ammonia production plant was discussed. Energy Baselines (EnBs) were identified according to ISO 50001 in order to evaluate the energy performance improvement actions [36–42]. In addition, the Significant Energy Users (SEUs) in the ammonia production plant were investigated to obtain a relation between independent; operating and production parameters and dependent; energy consumption parameters. In this study, the machine learning models were developed in Python programming language using a multiple linear regression algorithm based on supervised learning.

baseline_construction_method.value: Separate multiple-linear-regression baseline equations were constructed for each significant energy user from Aspen Hysys simulation data. The simulated data were split randomly into 80% training data and 20% testing data, with operating variables as independent variables and energy consumption as the dependent variable.
evidence_quote: The values of the relevant variables were changed together 3876 times for each SEU to extract the data that will be used for ML, full data sets are shown in Appendix C.

Data sets were split randomly into two groups: (1) Training data, 80 % of the data sets chosen randomly from the available data, this data was used to train the models and to develop the predictive equations, and (2) Testing data, 20 % of the data sets chosen randomly from the available data, this data was used to test and evaluate the model.

In this step, the engineering model was tested and evaluated using: the real data obtained from four actual ammonia plants, and the remaining 20 % of the data sets that were randomly selected from the simulation (see Appendix C and Appendix D); nearly 775 sample data for each energy intensive section.

The used criteria for evaluation are: R squared (>75 %) [42], mean absolute error, and maximum difference percentage (< +/- 5 %), Eq. (4). According to the results shown in Table 4 and Table 5, our ML model passed the set criteria.

identifies_model_limitations.evidence_quote: It worth mentioning that, in this study the refrigeration section was not considered as the amount of medium pressure steam consumed is almost constant because it is a closed loop. So, the amount of steam will change mainly due to the change in production capacity which is not the case for a given ammonia production plant.

value: Lack of awareness, knowledge, and experience in implementing energy-efficient industrial processes
Need for ongoing monitoring, analysis, optimization, and investment in new technologies and processes
evidence_quote: Generally, there is a lack of awareness, knowledge, and experience in the industry on how to implement energy-efficient processes [17,18].

Successful implementation of an energy management system requires commitment to ongoing monitoring, analysis, and optimization, as well as willingness to invest in new technologies and processes to improve energy efficiency and sustainability.
